profiles.Inventory: Collects configuration inventory without issuing most security conclusions.
profiles.Validation: Adds non-destructive validation. Requires an authorized, in-window engagement.
profiles.AdversarySimulation: Requires explicit adversary-simulation approval; this framework remains read-only and does not execute exploitation.

controls.title: No custom subscription-administrator roles exist
controls.expectedState: No custom RBAC role grants Actions:* at subscription or root scope.

controls.title: Subscription Owner assignments are limited
controls.expectedState: No more than the baseline threshold of Owner role assignments exist at subscription scope.

controls.title: Microsoft Defender for Cloud plans cover core workloads
controls.expectedState: Defender plans for servers, storage, and SQL are on the Standard tier.

controls.title: A Defender for Cloud security contact is configured
controls.expectedState: A security contact email address is configured for the subscription.

controls.title: Storage accounts require secure transfer
controls.expectedState: Every storage account sets supportsHttpsTrafficOnly to true.

controls.title: Storage accounts disallow blob public access
controls.expectedState: Every storage account sets allowBlobPublicAccess to false.

controls.title: Storage accounts enforce TLS 1.2 or higher
controls.expectedState: Every storage account sets minimumTlsVersion to TLS1_2 or newer.

controls.title: Storage account network access defaults to deny
controls.expectedState: Every storage account's network ACL default action is Deny.

controls.title: NSGs do not allow internet ingress to admin ports
controls.expectedState: No network security group allows inbound Internet/any traffic to ports 22 or 3389.

controls.title: Network Watcher is enabled in used locations
controls.expectedState: Network Watcher is provisioned in every location that hosts a virtual network.

controls.title: Virtual machines use managed disks
controls.expectedState: Every VM's OS and data disks are managed disks (no legacy VHD blobs).

controls.title: The subscription activity log is exported
controls.expectedState: A diagnostic setting exports Administrative, Security, Policy, and Alert activity-log categories.

controls.title: Azure SQL server auditing is enabled
controls.expectedState: Every Azure SQL server has auditing set to Enabled.

controls.title: Azure SQL servers block public network access
controls.expectedState: Every Azure SQL server sets publicNetworkAccess to Disabled.

controls.title: Key vaults are recoverable (soft delete and purge protection)
controls.expectedState: Every key vault enables soft delete and purge protection.

controls.title: Subscription break-glass procedure is documented
controls.expectedState: A documented, tested break-glass procedure exists for Global Administrator and subscription Owner access.
